# GSRTC Info - ગુજરાત એસટી બસ માર્ગદર્શક
> An independent, authoritative passenger guidance platform for GSRTC (Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation) bus travel in Gujarat, India.

## About The Project
- Website: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/
- Language: Gujarati (ગુજરાતી) & English
- Scope: GSRTC Bus Timetable, Online Ticket Booking, 25kg Baggage Allowance Rules, Concession Passes (Student, Senior Citizen, Divyang), Route Assistance, and Emergency Helplines (1800 233 6666, 108, 181, 112).

## Core Sections & Tools
- Home Page: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/
- Smart Packing Checklist: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/checklist
- Search & Knowledge Base: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/search
- HTML Sitemap: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/sitemap
- XML Sitemap: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
- RSS Feed: https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/feed.xml

## Main Categories
- Before Travel Guidance (મુસાફરી પહેલાં): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/before-travel
- During Travel Guidance (મુસાફરી દરમિયાન): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/during-travel
- Luggage Rules (સામાન નિયમો): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/luggage-rules
- Ticket Booking & Concession (ટિકિટ બુકિંગ & પાસ): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/ticket-booking
- Passenger Safety (મુસાફરોની સુરક્ષા): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/passenger-safety
- Special Assistance (વિશેષ મુસાફરો): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/special-passengers
- Women & Children Travel (મહિલા અને બાળ સુરક્ષા): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/women-children
- Senior Citizens & Health (વરિષ્ઠ નાગરિકો): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/seniors-health
- Monsoon & Road Safety (ચોમાસુ & રસ્તા સુરક્ષા): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/monsoon-safety
- Night Travel & Sleeper (રાત્રિ મુસાફરી & સ્લીપર): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/night-travel
- Station Amenities (બસ સ્ટેન્ડ સુવિધાઓ): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/station-amenities
- Emergency & Helplines (કટોકટી અને હેલ્પલાઇન): https://gsrtc-info.vercel.app/category/emergency-info

## Legal Disclaimer
This is an independent educational portal and is not affiliated with, authorized, or operated by Gujarat State Road Transport Corporation (GSRTC) or the Government of Gujarat.
